title: Clew theme file
description: Colours for an installation of Clew in the Design Tokens Community Group format (Format Module 2025.10). Clew draws light.color and dark.color; any other group is the file's own and may be referenced.

light.description: The colours of the light appearance. A token set here is set in the other appearance too.

color.description: Astryx's semantic colour tokens without the --color- prefix.
